name: telecode
description: Bridge VS Code and Telegram - control your IDE from anywhere

telecode.autoStart.description: Automatically start bot on VS Code startup

telecode.enableAIIntegration.description: Enable automatic AI responses via VS Code Language Model API

telecode.modelId.markdownDescription: Language model used for Telegram replies. Accepts a model `id` (e.g. `deepseek-v4-flash`), a `vendor/family` pair (e.g. `deepseek/deepseek`), or a `family` name. Leave empty to use the first available model. Run **TeleCode: Select AI Model** to pick one.

telecode.memory.fileContextChars.markdownDescription: Characters of remembered file content attached to every request. TeleCode keeps the files it read or edited (up to 40 per chat) so the model does not read them again; lower this to save tokens, raise it to hold more code in context. `0` disables file memory injection.

telecode.agent.autoTools.markdownDescription: Only offer coding tools when a message looks like a workspace request (a file path, command, code, or a work verb such as fix/build/run). Conversational messages like "where are we now?" are then answered directly instead of triggering file reads and shell commands. Set to `false` to always offer tools.

telecode.media.enabled.description: Allow the bot to generate images and videos through a media API such as Runware.

telecode.media.baseUrl.description: Media generation endpoint. Runware expects the full v1 URL.

telecode.media.imageModel.description: Image model identifier used by /image and telecode_generate_image.

telecode.media.videoModel.description: Video model identifier used by /video and telecode_generate_video. Required for video generation.

languageModelTools.name: telecode_read_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a file from the workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a text file from the workspace and return its contents with 1-based line numbers.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path inside the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: telecode_write_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create or overwrite a file in the workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create or overwrite a file in the workspace with the given content. Parent folders are created automatically.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path inside the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: telecode_list_dir
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the entries of a workspace directory.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List files and folders inside a workspace directory. Defaults to the workspace root.

path.description: Directory path, defaults to the workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: telecode_search
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search file contents in the workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search workspace file contents with a regular expression and return file:line matches.

languageModelTools.name: telecode_edit_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Replace an exact snippet in a file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace an exact snippet in a workspace file. Prefer this over rewriting a whole file. Fails when oldText is missing or ambiguous.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path inside the workspace.

oldText.description: Exact text to replace, copied from the file.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

languageModelTools.name: telecode_generate_image
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate an image and send it to the chat.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate an image from a text prompt with the configured media API (e.g. Runware) and send it to the Telegram chat. Use when the user asks for a picture, logo, illustration or diagram image.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the image to generate.

languageModelTools.name: telecode_generate_video
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate a short video and send it to the chat.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate a short video from a text prompt with the configured media API (e.g. Runware) and send it to the Telegram chat.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the video to generate.

languageModelTools.name: telecode_run_command
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a shell command in the workspace root.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in the workspace root (PowerShell on Windows, bash elsewhere) and return stdout, stderr and the exit code. Use for git, build and test commands.

scripts.install:local: npm run bump && npm run package && code --install-extension telecode.vsix --force
